universal_semantics.owner_set_abi: fixed 32-byte little-endian canonical bitset; bits >= expert_count must be zero; nonempty
universal_semantics.shape: one charged positive (hidden,intermediate) pair per expert, arbitrary within checked bounds
universal_semantics.coverage: every scalar interval of every role of every expert exactly once; no hole, overlap, empty expert, duplicate stream, or missing stream
universal_semantics.generic_adapter: charged semantic packet plus causal public-context and reconstruction callbacks
universal_semantics.evaluation_plugin: fixed STRATA15 adapter is explicitly non-universal and cannot widen the core claim
universal_semantics.production_grouping: adapter emits owner sets and exact per-owner per-role source intervals; common streams are stored once and fractional charging is ledger-only

candidate_bank.fit: exact uint64 counts; Jeffreys half-count; integer nearest Q0.16 rounding; clamp 1..65535
candidate_bank.reset_law: reset before t=0 lookup; encode/decode symbol; transition afterward

container.parser: bounds every integer/product/sum before loop, shift, allocation, or GPU conversion; rejects unknown/reserved/trailing/tampered/noncanonical data
container.standalone: deserialize transmitted model and reconstruct/re-encode from literal container plus universal decoder only
container.canonical_rebuild: integer-described and byte-identical; never infers a rate floor from floating bpw

cold_read.proof: fresh per-expert decoder using instrumented seek/read API after a separately reported installation authentication scan; causally decode/re-encode every owned payload and reconstruct all three matrices with no full-body/unowned-frame prepass
cold_read.owner_denominator: sum of exact bytes of private regions plus exact fair share of every shared/global region owned by that expert
cold_read.nonpadding_denominator: same owner-local allocation excluding literal padding
cold_read.numerator: exact union of 4096-byte pages touched by routed reads
cold_read.gate: maximum over experts and over total/nonpadding owner-local denominators is strictly below 2
cold_read.forbidden_shortcut: total container bytes divided by expert count

scientific_holdout.outer: total primary exact semantic-identity exclusion; unestimable legal panels return typed nonpromotion before fit; coordinate-disjoint folds are a nonpromoting diagnostic only when nonempty
scientific_holdout.selection: all 150 cells on every outer fold with exact validation physical lengths and deterministic ordinal tie
scientific_holdout.outer_score: refit winner on complete development and score untouched outer streams
scientific_holdout.weights: exact per-owner semantic contribution counts, never weight_count/popcount
scientific_holdout.confidence: two-sided Student-t with degrees of freedom derived from the actual nonempty fold count
scientific_holdout.heldout_gate: pooled saving meets 0.15288996696291447 bpw and confidence lower bound is positive

gaussian_controls.opening_gate: all source physical, F, cold, reconstruction, provenance, and heldout gates pass first
gaussian_controls.symmetry: each control repeats extraction, all-150 nested selection, refit, literal packing, parse, standalone decode, and scoring
gaussian_controls.bindings: source and control full geometry bind independently to their own artifact/score/reconstruction; only structural geometry is equal across sources; seed, generator, moment replay and pipeline bind before any fit

h2d: model frequency table on every copy
telemetry.d2h: reported separately for every explicit output transfer
execution: device UUID and PCI bus id matched to independent identity
telemetry.resource_admission: static declared-cap proof plus measured current RSS/free-VRAM gate before host concatenation or CuPy allocation
telemetry.representative_benchmark: source-free 15-stream/6-owner complete outer fold with all-150 selection/refit and transparent 13-pipeline full-scale projection
telemetry.final_evidence: must be rerun from the exact public Git commit on RTX 5090 after freeze; development direct copies are non-authoritative

diagnostic_handoff.binding: literal container, source artifact/score/full+structural geometry, extraction/decoder/adapter sources, semantic and immutable context state, serialized model, full FP64 reconstruction, and per-stream decoded selected-bit/level/base-u16le triplet commitments
diagnostic_handoff.consumption: a separately frozen diagnostic must causally re-decode the authenticated literal container and reproduce the decision commitment

trust_and_lifecycle.direct_producer_launch: always inert before argument or dynamic input access
trust_and_lifecycle.authority: independently pinned external bootstrap authenticates manifest, review, entrypoint, and every exact source byte and executes held snapshots under python -I -B
trust_and_lifecycle.path_safety: reject symlink leaf and every ancestor; retain authenticated input and output-parent file descriptors; publish staging by renameat2 NOREPLACE; post-rename faults never delete final members
trust_and_lifecycle.manifest_state: must remain absent until independent postimplementation review authorizes freeze

claim_boundary.source_only: producer tests establish format/arithmetic/coverage/telemetry contracts on synthetic bytes only
claim_boundary.payload_performance: not measured or authorized by this tree
claim_boundary.universality: portable codec grammar and adapter protocol for SwiGLU-MoE; no universal performance claim from one family
claim_boundary.negative_result: closes only this exact sparse-unifilar recoder, not arbitrary WFA/MPS/MERA/flow/RCC/Gray-Wyner or another quantizer
